description: Cross-repository score_version contract. Bumping either side without the other must fail CI.

probe_evidence_tag.role: Generation tag recall-web stamps on probe_evidence rows and filters POST /validator/v3/metrics by. It is not a validator score version: the validator never sees it, and changing it would empty the v3 evidence windows.

notes: Incentive v3 (score_version 11) is the only scoring path; the validator no longer calls POST /validator/tier-scores (score_version 10).
Historical journal recovery of v5/v7/v8/v9/v10 INTENT/PENDING/UNKNOWN envelopes remains allowed via parse_bundle_for_journal_recovery.
Historical recovery is NOT permission to ingest unsupported *new* versions.
Pinned to recall-web commit 362b8d11754919887cf032c80d647fb9dccbe4ff for the v3ScoreVersion 11 constant. The constant excerpt omits upstream operational comments.
When recall-web bumps v3ScoreVersion, update this contract (release_sha + constant_line) in the same window that bumps SUPPORTED_SCORE_VERSION.
